steps.content: The only shop in business is a little florist with a welcome sign on it.
Rahu furrows her brows and lifts up her shields in vigilance. A strange smell wafts out from behind the door—the same as the floral scent last night, but stronger and more nauseating here.
She pushes the door gently. As soon as it opens a crack, she sees a thin thread behind it, and also hears a mechanical trigger.
Rahu immediately dodges away from the door, which gets riddled by bullets.
The sirens on the street starts blaring loudly.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: A temporary trap set no more than four hours ago. Is it designed for me...?
She fastens her mask, her eyes gleaming with excitement.
Swinging her shields, she severs all the spikes and destroys most of the traps. The siren still hasn't stopped. The enemy had obviously set off the alarm on purpose.
Rahu looks at the time. It's been less than two minutes. She turns around and rushes out of the florist. Clearly, incidents have unfolded in more than one place.

Coming out in full force, the sheriffs are immediately distracted by the sirens ringing everywhere. Many run around in confusion like headless chickens. On the other end of the comms, someone is anxiously asking about Rahu's condition.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: There are smoke bombs everywhere. The assassin is really trying hard...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: What a great decision it was to spare you last night.
She leaves the comms device on the spot. She quickly observes the sheriffs' movements, then picks a discreet path in the opposite direction to rush back to the villa.
